211.approach: Each recursive state pairs a trie node with the next pattern position, preserving exactly the matched prefix.
211.cost: Insert O(L). Search explores matching trie states: O(min(T,L·26^w)) up to a fixed alphabet factor, with w wildcards, T nodes, and length L>=1; O(L) recursion space. Storage O(26T). Wildcards can be expensive.

648.title: Replace Words
648.prompt: Replace each lowercase sentence word by its shortest dictionary root prefix, if any.
hints: Stop at the first terminal trie node while reading each word.
Build a trie of roots, scan each word until a terminal or missing edge.
648.approach: The first terminal encountered is the shortest matching root, so longer roots need not be explored.
648.cost: O(D+S) time for total dictionary characters D and sentence length S; O(26D+S) space for trie, split words, and output.
648.example: roots=["cat","bat","rat"], "the cattle was rattled" → "the cat was rat"

136.title: Single Number
136.prompt: Every integer appears twice except one. Find the single value in linear time and constant space.
hints: Find an operation that cancels identical pairs regardless of order.
XOR all values: x XOR x=0 and x XOR 0=x.
136.approach: Associativity and commutativity let all paired values cancel, leaving the unique value.
136.cost: O(n) time and O(1) space. Works for negative Java int values too, since XOR operates on fixed-width bits.

191.title: Number of 1 Bits
191.prompt: Count set bits in the integer’s binary representation.
hints: What happens to the lowest set bit when subtracting one?
Repeatedly apply n &= n-1 to clear the lowest set bit.
191.approach: Each iteration removes exactly one 1 without changing the count of higher set bits.
191.cost: O(b) time for b set bits, at most 32 for a Java int; therefore O(1) for fixed-width ints. O(1) space.

338.title: Counting Bits
338.prompt: Return the number of set bits for every integer from 0 to n.
hints: Removing the lowest binary digit leaves a smaller solved value.
bits[i]=bits[i >>> 1]+(i & 1).
338.approach: The right shift removes the final bit; adding its value reconstructs the count.
338.cost: O(n) time, O(n) output space, and O(1) auxiliary space beyond the returned array.

79.title: Word Search
79.prompt: Determine whether a word can be traced through four-directionally adjacent board cells without reusing a cell within one path.
hints: Different attempted paths need different visitation histories.
Try each start; temporarily mark a matching cell, search the next character, then restore it.
79.approach: The board mark represents only the current recursion path, not every cell visited by earlier failed searches.
79.cost: O(RC·4^L) loose upper-bound time for word length L; O(min(L,RC)) recursion depth up to a constant terminal frame. The original board is restored. Pruning usually makes the actual search much smaller.

714.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee
714.prompt: Trade any number of times, hold at most one share, and pay fee once per completed transaction. Maximize profit.
hints: The best future choice depends on whether you currently own a share.
Track cash (not holding) and hold (holding); compute both next states from the previous day’s states.
714.approach: cash and hold are optimal values after the processed days under their respective inventory states. Their legal transitions exhaust all actions.
714.cost: O(n) time and O(1) space. Fee is charged exactly once, on selling. Return cash because an unsold share is not realized profit.

76.title: Minimum Window Substring
76.prompt: Return the shortest substring of s containing every character of t with multiplicity, or an empty string. Inputs contain English letters.
hints: A valid window must satisfy counts, not merely contain each distinct character once.
Maintain a deficit array and the total number of still-missing characters. Expand, then shrink while nothing is missing.
76.approach: A zero missing count means every target occurrence is covered. Removing an essential occurrence makes the window invalid again.
76.cost: O(|s|+|t|) time including output copying. O(1) count-array space for the fixed alphabet, O(|t|) temporary toCharArray allocation in this implementation, plus O(answer length) returned substring.
